question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is: **readable**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Readable" **refers to text that is easy to read and understand. (पठनीय)

 
 
• **Example: **The font size on the website was increased to make the content more readable for users.
 
 
 
• The context tells us that how perceptive, readable, well-organized, and focused it (the book) is impresses me.
 
• Hence, we can infer that the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4 is **'readable'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **readable**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Sophisticated **(परिष्कृत): Having, revealing, or involving a great deal of worldly experience and knowledge of fashion and culture.

 
 
• **Example:** Her sophisticated taste in music impressed everyone at the party.
 
 
 
• **Pessimistic **(निराशावादी ): Tending to see the worst aspect of things or believe that the worst will happen.
 
 
• **Example: **He has a pessimistic outlook on life and always expects things to go wrong.
 
 
 
• **Cumbersome** (भारी): Large or heavy and therefore difficult to carry or use; unwieldy.
 
 
• **Example:** The cumbersome package was difficult to move up the stairs.
